assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE production transparent raster game background layer for NEON OVERDRIVE VOID, gate. Subject: isolated black hole, opaque near-black circular core with thin dim violet and muted amber accretion disc and a lensed arc above, whole silhouette visible with generous margins. Fine crisp pixel art with deliberate clusters at about 360 virtual pixels across, no chunky blocks, not photorealistic. Palette: near-black violet and indigo glass, subdued purple rims with very sparse dull amber seams. Almost black material, restrained thin colored edges; much darker than arcade ships and projectiles. Landscape 1536x1024. Landmark fills central 75 percent, preserve all silhouette within frame. No skyline. Genuine alpha background outside structures, NOT opaque black, NOT painted checkerboard. No sky, stars, grid, floor plane, UI, text, logo, watermarks, ships, characters, targets, bullets, pickups, bright white or green/lime lights. No bright scattered dots or wide bloom.
